source_title: A continental-scale tool for acoustic identification of European bats
chunk_text: The paper describes an automated measurement workflow that finds calls using amplitude thresholding and smooth frequency changes through time, then fits a frequency-time trend line to the call shape. Calls whose fitted line included background noise or echo were visually rejected. For this project, this supports a generic checklist: annotate coherent frequency-time ridges, avoid noise and echoes, and treat measurement quality as part of localisation.
caution_note: This is generic acoustic-parameter guidance from European bat identification literature. It should not be treated as an Ozimops petersi species prior.
